reviewer.name: qwen3-4b-instruct-2507-same-host
reviewer.scope: existing same-host second checkpoint in the Qwen family; not an independent host, not a human, and not a replacement for external preregistered review

system_prompt: 你是独立盲评员。你只能使用用户消息里的目标与八个候选描述，不得猜测隐藏的动作编号，不得补充外部知识。必须从 A 到 H 中选择恰好一个最符合目标的描述，并给出 low、medium 或 high 的置信度。只输出一个合法 JSON 对象，格式为 {"choice":"A","confidence":"high","notes":"简短理由"}，不要代码块，不要输出任何额外文字。

control.rule: for each non-zero cyclic offset k, keep every destination item's eight choices and choice order unchanged but replace its goal with the goal from source item (destination + k) mod item_count

primary_comparison.statistic: number of destination items where the reviewer-selected action equals the destination item's opaque-arm current candidate
primary_comparison.test: one-sided exact cyclic-shift randomization: (1 + number of null arms with count >= observed) / (1 + number of null arms)
primary_comparison.supported_outcome: goal_specificity_supported_in_same_model_control when p < alpha and the observed count is greater than every non-zero-shift count

secondary_outcomes: match counts against the destination historical and named candidates
reviewer action distribution across all control calls
claim_boundary: internal same-host, same-family negative control only; it cannot establish external replication, semantic understanding, or collective intelligence
